name: Leonard Von Berkeley
original_name: レナード＝フォン＝バークレイ
source:
"My duty is to present a glimpse of a dream world to all the beautiful women."

A noble of the country of Astrica and an actor in the church plays.
His family has been nobility for a long time, but after his parents death the legacy is crumbling and he lives simply in an old mansion only with his old butler [url=/c42796]Henry[/url].
He's good at negotiation, but he can only share his good side with women and often looks down at other men.
